name: Saudi Arabia
description: Follow Saudi Arabia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Daily fragment: Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan sign the Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement.

changes.title: Rising gas prices fuel protests in countries around the world
changes.summary: Protests over rising fuel protest are happening around the world, a ripple effect as the Us war on Iran is dragging Saudi Arabia in deeper.

changes.title: How the fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia is affecting gas prices
changes.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with oil markets expert Ellen R. Wald of the Atlantic Council about how the escalation in fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia is affecting global oil and gas prices.

changes.title: U.S. Intelligence Warns of China Theft Over Sale of F-35 Jets to Saudis
changes.summary: Internal reports, including one from the Pentagon’s Defense Intelligence Agency, say China could acquire U.S. jet technology through spying or cooperation with Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of attacking Mecca, warns holy city is a ‘red line’
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has accused the Iran-backed Houthi rebels of attempting to attack Islam’s holiest city, declaring Mecca a “red line” in the escalating conflict.

changes.title: US officials decide against backing Saudi Arabia in Yemen after meeting Houthi leaders
changes.summary: Armed group appears to reach agreement with Trump administration over safety of Red Sea shipping Officials from the US met Houthi leaders over the weekend at the country’s embassy in Muscat, Oman, it has been confirmed, leading to the US decision not to intervene to help Saudi Arabia drive back a Houthi advance inside.

changes.title: Oil Prices Jump on Energy Supply Worries
changes.summary: Traders sold oil futures on concerns that energy supplies from the Persian Gulf would be further diminished by a drone attack on a critical pipeline in Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia's critical pipeline remains shut as oil prices soar
changes.summary: The East-West pipeline in Saudi Arabia remains shut after a drone attack last week, a major hit to the supply of oil flowing out of the country. Saudi Arabia blamed the attack on Iranian-backed militias in Iraq. Threadneedle founder Ann Berry joins to discuss.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia has few options as it faces mounting threats from Iran and its allies
changes.summary: A lightning advance by Houthi rebels threatens a crucial Red Sea shipping route. Drone attacks blamed on Iraqi militias have forced the closure of a major pipeline, and Iran is still disrupting the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia’s Oil ‘Lifeline’ Was Attacked. Here’s What to Know.
changes.summary: A drone attack from Iraq forced Saudi Arabia to close its East-West pipeline, the kingdom said, threatening a key workaround to Iran’s Persian Gulf blockade.
